title.en: MALAGANANG RESIDENCE OF THE PRESIDENT OF THE PHILIPPINES BY THE FRESIDENT OF THE FHILIPPINES DECREEING THE USE OF VOTER'S IDENTIFICATION CARD ISSUED BY THE COMMISSION ON LLECTIONS FOR IDENTIFICATION FURFOSES IN TRANSACTIONS WITH ANY GOVERIMENT OFFICE OR GOVERNMENT-OWNDD OR CONTROLLED CORFORATION.

text.en:
by the Commission on Elections pursuant to Republic
Act No. 3588, as amended, for identification pur-
poses in connection with any transaction with any
government office or government-owned or controlled
corporation, wherein identification may be required
and to require said government offices to accept
the voter's identification card as a sufficient
means or identification.
this 16th day of'
red and sixty-nine.
(SGD.) FERDINAND B. MARCOS
President of the Philippines
By the Fresident:
(SGD.) ERNESTO M. MACEDA
Executive Secretary
